## Context
The default suite passes but `tests/unit/test_provider_parity.py::test_the_outbound_payload_is_equivalent_across_providers[frontier]` and `tests/unit/test_agent_build_invariants.py::test_usage_limits_on_run_not_constructor` emit `DeprecationWarning: There is no current event loop` from `pydantic_ai/_utils.py:1128`. Research ticket sandstone-fiendish-auk (RP-01) has also observed two non-failing Pydantic event-loop warnings, but no dedicated open bug owns remediation.

## Reproduction
Run the two named tests with the warning promoted to an error and capture the production call path into pydantic-ai.

## Plan
Use rebar-debug to distinguish a rebar lifecycle defect from an upstream pydantic-ai compatibility defect. Coordinate remediation with the separate RP-01 session; do not change provider behavior or event-loop ownership without user review.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A deterministic warning-as-error reproduction identifies the first rebar-owned call site and the upstream boundary.
- [x] The ticket records whether remediation belongs in rebar, dependency policy, or upstream.
- [x] The named tests pass without the event-loop deprecation warning after the approved remediation.
- [x] Provider parity and agent-build invariants remain unchanged.
